findings.quote: 5‐MeO‐DMT is a fast‐acting tryptamine that can induce an immediate (within seconds) and intense psychedelic experience of short duration (10–20 min). Core to the psychedelic experience is the feeling of ego dissolution, described as a sense of oneness with the universe or the experience of relaxed boundaries between the self and the world, in the absence of visual imagery.
findings.text: 5-MeO-DMT is a fast-acting tryptamine that induces an immediate and intense psychedelic experience lasting 10 to 20 minutes, featuring feelings of ego dissolution as a sense of oneness with the universe without visual imagery.

findings.quote: Subjective effects following 5‐MeO‐DMT administration include distortions in auditory and time perception, amplification of emotional states, and feelings of ego dissolution that usually are short‐lasting, depending on the route of administration.
